agent.answer:
Under the reviewed individual savings rule, you qualify through your ₹12 lakh in qualifying deposits plus account balance despite zero eligible spending. The three routes are alternatives: ₹10,000 previous-quarter debit spending OR ₹10 lakh deposits plus account balance OR ₹50 lakh total programme relationship. Meeting one suffices; spending is not mandatory for this account category. [icici-wealth]

The rule is effective from 1 August 2025 and was reviewed on 3 October 2026. Your savings account opened on 1 September 2025 meets the opening-date requirement, and you report maintaining the Wealth Management Programme. For travel on 10 October 2026, the preceding spend quarter is 1 July–30 September 2026, with access starting 5 October. Your ₹0 spending fails only the spending route; ₹12 lakh exceeds the separate ₹10 lakh balance threshold. [icici-wealth]

The authoritative verdict is qualified: you have used 1 of 2 quarterly visits, leaving 1. [icici-wealth]

Your relationship manager’s statement conflicts with the reviewed FAQ’s individual savings alternatives. Ask the bank to reconcile that advice with the dated FAQ; the supplied statement does not change the reviewed verdict.

DEL T3 domestic remains unverified in the pilot, which does not mean it is excluded from the bank directory. Exact lounge admission is separately subject to the reviewed directory and bank/operator validation; entry is not guaranteed. Present the exact eligible Wealth World card and check the bank list before travelling. [icici-wealth]
